name: NewsSum-Bench
description: Initial release of the NewsSum-Bench research framework and benchmark for abstractive text summarization. Key Features & Contents:- Multi-model fine-tuning pipelines and evaluation notebooks for state-of-the-art Transformer architectures (T5, BART, PEGASUS, mT5, and BERT).- Custom data processing and preprocessing scripts for sentence tokenization.- Quantitative evaluation utilizing ROUGE metrics (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L).- Interactive Streamlit web interface prototype for real-time article summarization.
